title: Attribute telemetry cost by team with Fleet Management

blocks.content:
Welcome to the Grafana Fleet Management learning path that shows you how to attribute Grafana Cloud telemetry cost to the teams that own your collectors.

The `team` attribute you assign to a collector in Fleet Management describes the collector, not the telemetry it sends. In this path, you use a configuration pipeline to add the `team` attribute to your metrics as a label. Then you use that label in Cost Management and Billing to see how much each team spends.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Explain how a collector attribute becomes an attribution label
- Create a configuration pipeline that adds the `team` label to your metrics
- Confirm that the `team` label appears on your metrics
- Configure `team` as a cost attribution label in Cost Management and Billing
- Review cost by team and find unattributed cost

## Before you begin

Before you attribute cost by team, ensure that you have:

- Linux collectors that run Grafana Alloy and are registered in Fleet Management. The pipeline in this path collects Linux host metrics.
- The `team` attribute assigned to those collectors in Fleet Management. To assign it, refer to the [Categorize a collector fleet](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/categorize-collector-fleet/) learning path.
- The `GCLOUD_RW_API_KEY` environment variable set on those collectors. The variable holds an access policy token with the `metrics:write` scope.
- The Prometheus remote write URL and username for your stack. Refer to [Find instance endpoints](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/security-and-account-management/cloud-stacks/#find-instance-endpoints) for details.
- **Admin** permissions in Grafana Cloud to create configuration pipelines.
- The **Cost attribution admin** role to configure attribution labels. Refer to [Role-based access control for Cost Management and Billing](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/cost-management-and-billing/set-up/cost-management-billing-rbac/) for more information.
- The **Cost attribution reader** role to view the attribution report. The **Cost attribution admin** role already includes read access.

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.
